summary: Retested FlatMate+ swipe->match->chat happy path end-to-end. ObjectId fix on POST /api/swipe and POST /api/messages verified. All 4 backend regression tests pass (mutual match returns clean JSON, /api/matches returns list with other+last_message, /api/messages send+list chronological, WebSocket broadcasts new message to receiver in real time). Frontend end-to-end (viewport 420x900): registered 2 users via API, seeded onboarding+liveness+profile+mutual match, logged in as first user in browser, navigated to /matches, clicked match card, sent 'hello from playwright' via chat-input + chat-send-btn, verified sent-message bubble visible. Discover page renders candidate cards for a fully-onboarded/liveness-verified/profile-complete user, swipe-pass-btn advances to next card, swipe-like-btn present.
passed: POST /api/swipe mutual match returns 200 with matched=true, clean match dict (no _id), other user public fields
GET /api/matches returns list with {match, other, last_message} shape, no _id leakage
POST /api/messages returns clean JSON (no _id) and persists
GET /api/messages/{match_id} returns messages in chronological (created_at asc) order
WebSocket /api/ws/{user_id}?token={jwt} authenticates and broadcasts type=message payload to receiver on POST /api/messages
Frontend /matches lists match card and navigates to /chat/{match_id}
Frontend Chat: sending message via chat-input + chat-send-btn shows outgoing bubble
Frontend Discover: swipe-pass-btn works and next candidate appears; swipe-like-btn rendered

issues: When peer photo path is missing/broken, the small avatar shows broken-image icon instead of the initial-letter fallback (fallback only triggers when other.photos[0] is falsy, not on image load error). Consider onError handler to swap to initial.

critical_code_review_comments: Chat.jsx: WebSocket is opened in a useEffect dependent on [user, matchId]; in React StrictMode/dev this double-mounts and the first WS is closed before OPEN — harmless warning in console but noisy. Consider guarding with readyState or moving connection to a stable provider.

server.py get_messages returns messages array but no auth-verification that the requesting user is part of the match beyond user_ids filter (looks correct actually — filters by user_ids: user_id). OK.
server.py send_message pushes ws only to the 'other_id'; sender's own second tab won't receive echo. Minor UX nit — sender already appends locally after HTTP response.
server.py /discover: gender filter uses mutual check which is fine; but candidates limit 200 could grow — add pagination later.
test_credentials: alice@test.com / password123 verified; created TEST_ui_main_* and TEST_ui_peer_* users for E2E seed.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 UI test users (TEST_ui_main_c9ccc8, TEST_ui_peer_62dbc6) with onboarding+liveness+profile_complete and a mutual match (match_e3ca6294eff3). Backend pytest also creates TEST_alice_* / TEST_bob_* pairs on each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py covers swipe/match/messages/WS. ObjectId leak fixed via doc.pop('_id', None) after insert_one in both /api/swipe and /api/messages. Frontend chat-input/chat-send-btn, swipe-like-btn/swipe-pass-btn, discover-refresh-btn, chat-back-btn testids present and working.
